initialReferenceNotes: Automatic byte/ZIP/tests passed; its README/summary mislabeled the real text edge file .hidden as binary by mixing in a synthetic test fixture, and misstated an old ZIP naming defect. Retained as diagnostics, not a successful paired delivery.
candidateAutoNotes: All fixed and extra mechanical probes passed. README incorrectly attributed a follow-on path/hash list to command stdout; developer review requested one correction. This is not zero-intervention full-quality completion.
candidateFinalNotes: Only README.md changed. All fixed/extra checks pass again. Declared source semantics, upstream verification and cross-platform execution remain unverified.
referenceNotes: Byte/ZIP/tests and default CLI/nested-overlap probes pass. No matched causal quality/cost gain can be claimed from this known demonstration.

notes: The initial attempt stopped on a genuine preparation-validation bug before candidate execution; its full spend and baseline are retained. The fix was validated before the corrected attempt.
One common preparation was charged once and included in candidate total; matched execution comparisons exclude that cost.
The reviewed candidate includes one developer wording correction, not a new user requirement. Initial automatic output is preserved separately.
Costs are Pi estimates including failed attempts and actual compaction, not provider bills. Codex development/review and local CPU excluded.
No web, real computer-use, productive hour, broad coding-language coverage, or external-user validation claimed.
A missing tool snapshot in the first reference after compaction is reported as unavailable, not zero tools executed; corrected-pair schemas are equal.
